name: Ground Plane Antenna
description: A ground plane antenna is a quarter-wave vertical radiator with multiple radials that act as a reflective ground surface. It provides omnidirectional coverage and is widely used on HF, VHF, and UHF bands.
modelingNotes: Radial angle affects feedpoint impedance and bandwidth.
More radials improve pattern symmetry and efficiency.
Mutual coupling between radials influences impedance.
Mounting height determines horizon gain and takeoff angle.
A true ground plane requires at least 3–4 radials.
